prompts.short:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished full-bleed portrait card painting for the existing CosyWorld fantasy storybook game; exact canvas 1024 by 1536 pixels, 2:3 portrait, opaque.
Primary request: Short Rest — "a moment by the road". A travel cloak draped on a mossy roadside stone at dusk, a tin cup of steaming tea, a heel of bread, a leaning satchel, and fireflies. Amber sunset against blue twilight.
Style/medium: whimsical painterly fantasy storybook illustration with softly brushed gouache and oil-like paint, tactile moss, woven wool, worn leather and muted metal. A warm refuge within an endless dream. Rich painted surfaces, atmospheric depth, restrained luminous details; recognizably hand-painted rather than photographic or a polished 3D render. Palette of hearth honey, moss green, worn oak brown and night indigo.
Composition: the cloak, stone, cup, bread and satchel form one intimate, legible still-life in the central upper three quarters. A quiet path recedes behind it into dusk. Make the steaming tin cup and cloak readable even as a small card. Full artwork extends to all four edges. The entire lower quarter is naturally dark, low-contrast twilight ground with very little detail, leaving room for a future UI caption; no hard rectangle or abrupt gradient. Keep all essential objects above the lower quarter and within generous safe margins.
Lighting/mood: gentle amber sunset grazes the cloak, tea steam and moss against cool blue shadows; just a few fireflies, a feeling of earned respite.
Constraints: no people, humanoid shapes, faces, creatures, additional equipment, buildings, text, letters, numbers, words, title, logo, border, frame, watermark or UI. The cloak is empty and rests naturally on the stone. Tea cup is plain tin with a simple handle. This is one complete painting, not a sheet, collage or mockup.
prompts.long:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished full-bleed portrait card painting for the existing CosyWorld fantasy storybook game; exact canvas 1024 by 1536 pixels, 2:3 portrait, opaque.
Primary request: Long Rest — "the sanctuary bed". A quiet stone alcove containing an inviting quilted bedroll and folded wool blanket, a single candle in a niche, an arched window showing a full moon and stars, a lavender sprig on the pillow, and faint star motes drifting toward the bed. Candle gold, moonlight silver, deep indigo.
Style/medium: whimsical painterly fantasy storybook illustration with softly brushed gouache and oil-like paint, tactile old stone, stitched quilting and woven wool. A warm refuge within an endless dream. Rich painted surfaces, atmospheric depth, restrained luminous details; recognizably hand-painted rather than photographic or a polished 3D render. This pairs with a roadside Short Rest painting in the same painterly world.
Composition: intimate view into the alcove, all essential objects in the upper three quarters. The empty bedroll is comfortable and carefully made, with a visible pillow and identifiable lavender sprig. The arched window and moon sit in the upper half, the single candle visible in its niche. The whole lower quarter is naturally dark, low-contrast indigo foreground with very little detail, leaving room for a future UI caption; no hard rectangle or abrupt gradient. Full artwork extends to every edge; generous safe margins around main objects.
Lighting/mood: candle gold touches the folded blanket and rough stone; silver moonlight falls softly over the quilt; a few tiny, faint star motes drift gently down toward the bed. Deep restful indigo shadows, safe, still and dreamlike.
Constraints: no people, sleepers, humanoid shapes, faces, creatures, additional candles, religious symbols, text, letters, numbers, title, logo, border, frame, watermark or UI. The bed is visibly empty. This is one complete painting, not a sheet, collage or mockup.
